Callout.Name: Possible Carbon Monoxide
Callout.Message: Family feeling unwell in a house, boiler suspected.
Callout.Advisory: Four people, all drowsy and headachy.

Lines.Approach: Four of them, all drowsy, all with headaches, and all in the same house. Get them out first.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
